measures.name: Public Measure A - Emmetsburg Community School District General Obligation Bonds
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Board of Directors of the Emmetsburg Community School District in the County of Palo Alto, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $25,000,000, to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip a new elementary school, including site acquisition and site improvements, and for partial demolition of the existing elementary school, and to repair and improve the remaining portion of the existing elementary building, including site improvements?

measures.name: Public Measure B - Fairfield Township officers by appointment
measures.ballotLanguage: Should the Palo Alto County Board of Supervisors fill the offices of Trustee and Clerk of Fairfield Township by appointment as the terms of the office of the incumbent township officers expires?

measures.name: Public Measure C - Silver Lake Township officers by appointment
measures.ballotLanguage: Should the Palo Alto County Board of Supervisors fill the offices of Trustee and Clerk of Silver Lake Township by appointment as the terms of the office of the incumbent township officers expires?

measures.name: Public Measure D - West Bend Township officers by appointment

measures.name: Public Measure HF - North Union Community School District General Obligation Bonds
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Board of Directors of the North Union Community School District in the Counties of Emmet, Kossuth and Palo Alto, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $12,000,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip additions to the school building, including a gymnasium, multipurpose room, and related spaces, and to improve the site?

measures.name: Public Measure RQ - Pocahontas Area Community School District General Obligation Bonds
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Board of Directors of the Pocahontas Area Community School District in the Counties of Pocahontas, Calhoun and Palo Alto, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $20,000,000 to provide funds to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the middle/high school and elementary school, including career and technical education and classroom spaces; to build, furnish, and equip additions to the middle/high school and elementary school, including site improvements; for playground improvements at the elementary school; and to build, furnish, and equip a central office and regional learning center building and a transportation facility, including site improvements?

notes: Source is a 40-page image-only sample ballot PDF (20 ballot styles); names and measure text transcribed visually from rendered pages, so verify spellings against the auditor if precision matters.
